BRAKE SYSTEM – BRAKE BOOSTER

BRAKE BOOSTER
BRAKE BOOSTER REMOVAL

Master Cylinder
Brake Booster
♦Gasket
Pedal Bracket
Stay
Clip
Return Spring
Clevis Pin
Clevis
♦Gasket
w/ TRAC:
TRAC Pump Assembly
w/ TRAC:
TRAC Actuator Assembly

♦ Non-reusable part

R11184

R09739

R07122

1. REMOVE THESE PARTS:
• Master cylinder (See page BR–11)
• Vacuum hose
• Clip, clevis pin and return spring
w/ TRAC:
• TRAC actuator assembly (See page BR–121)
• TRAC pump assembly (See page BR–118)
2. REMOVE PEDAL BRACKET STAY
(a) Remove the steering column assembly.
(See page SR–14)
(b) Remove the bolt and nut.
(c) Remove the pedal bracket stay.
3. REMOVE BRAKE BOOSTER
(a) Remove the booster installation nuts.
(b) Remove the booster and gasket.
